en: Colorized vintage view of a large Romanesque cathedral facing an open piazza with a central ornate fountain and a horse-drawn carriage. The scene is surrounded by multi-story buildings with red-tiled roofs, set against a mountainous backdrop. At the top center of the image, red text reads "Trient - Trento." The composition and printing style are typical of early 20th‑century European postcards.
